newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil telecom ratings reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil telecom ratings reiterated.

text.p: Caspian Securities said in a report it was maintaining its buy ratings on Brazilian telecommunications firms Telebras and Telemig.
-- It also said it was maintaining its market performer rating on Telerj and Telesp.
-- The report came after the announcement of the names of qualified bidders for the Band B cellular sell-off.

-- It said, "Although the introduction of competition in cellular services should take some market share away from Telebras, with pent-up demand estimated at well over one million, we believe competition is healthy and could actually help to stimulate demand/traffic and generate access fees."
-- It also said the amount paid by winning bidders could also serve as an indication of the inherent value of Telebras' cellular operations.
-- Telebras preferred was up 0.49 percent at 143.50 reais.
-- Telerj preferred was off 0.64 percent at 164.95 reais.
-- Telesp preferred fell 0.29 percent to 344 reais.
-- Telemig preferred dropped 0.29 percent at 173 reais. All three stock prices are from trade on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
